sections.title: Define the work you need
sections.body: List the recurring tasks your team struggles to finish. Ask who collects records, resolves exceptions, processes payroll and updates the books.

sections.title: Review one real exception
sections.body: Use a missed punch or tip correction to understand where the record is kept, who confirms it and what happens near cutoff.

sections.title: Confirm tax and local responsibilities
sections.body: Ask which jurisdiction-specific tasks, filings and advice are included and who remains responsible. Have applicable requirements confirmed by the relevant authority or qualified adviser.

sections.title: Check approvals and corrections
sections.body: Request a clear approval sequence and a process for late changes. Confirm which version reaches payroll and how the explanation is retained.

sections.title: Compare the full scope and price
sections.body: Check ongoing support, bookkeeping connections, implementation and any separate charges. Compare providers against the same responsibilities.
